name: Kelindan Chat
author: ikyprima

sections.description:
Kelindan Chat embeds an interactive floating AI chatbot widget connected directly to your AI Knowledge Base. It includes 1-Click Onboarding directly from WP-Admin, automatic WordPress page and post content synchronization, and customizable AI disclaimer labels in the widget footer.

Key Features

  • Instant 1-Click Onboarding: Connect your WordPress site to kelindan.virtual.ai.id in seconds directly from WP-Admin without manually creating an API key.
  • Automatic Web Content Sync: Turn your WordPress FAQ pages, blog posts, and company profile into an AI knowledge base with one click.
  • Real-Time Streaming Responses: Fast and interactive AI replies via Server-Sent Events (SSE).
  • Smart Contextual RAG: Answers visitor questions accurately based strictly on the documents and articles you select.
  • AI Disclaimer Label Option: Transparently informs visitors that responses are generated by an AI assistant.
  • Visitor Insights: Monitor the most frequently asked questions from your site visitors directly from your WordPress dashboard.

External 3rd-Party SaaS Service Disclosure

This plugin connects your WordPress site to our external SaaS service at kelindan.virtual.ai.id for text processing, vector indexing (Qdrant), and LLM AI inference.
* Official Service: kelindan.virtual.ai.id
* Terms of Service: https://kelindan.virtual.ai.id/terms
* Privacy Policy: https://kelindan.virtual.ai.id/privacy

Text content sent during manual synchronization or visitor chat queries is processed solely to generate responses for your site and is never shared with third parties for public model training.
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress admin dashboard.
  2. Search for “Kelindan Chat”, then click Install Now and Activate.
  3. Open the kelindan AI menu in your WordPress admin sidebar (or click Settings on the Plugins page).
  4. Click “Hubungkan Sekarang & Aktifkan Chatbot” on the 1-Click Setup tab to provision your Free Tier account automatically.
  5. In the Basis Pengetahuan tab, select the pages or posts you want to sync and click Sinkronkan Halaman Terpilih ke AI.
  6. Your AI chatbot widget is now live on your WordPress site!
sections.faq:
Do I need to pay to use this plugin?

No. When activated via 1-Click Onboarding, you automatically receive a Free Tier plan with monthly chat quota and knowledge base capacity. If your site requires higher limits, you can upgrade anytime via the kelindan.virtual.ai.id dashboard.

Is my site content secure?

Yes. Every tenant on kelindan.virtual.ai.id is strictly isolated using multi-tenant vector isolation. Your data is only used to answer questions on your own website.

What if I already have an API Key from kelindan.virtual.ai.id?

You can switch to the “Input API Key Manual” tab on the plugin settings page and enter your sk-... API key.
sections.changelog:
1.3.0

  • Added 1-Click Onboarding directly from WP-Admin without manual key creation.
  • Added WordPress page and post synchronization module for the RAG knowledge base.
  • Added quota summary and visitor insights dashboard.
  • Improved security: replaced cURL with WordPress HTTP API, added register_setting sanitization callbacks, and enforced output escaping across templates.

1.2.2

  • Added custom AI disclaimer label option in the floating widget footer.
  • Improved streaming connection reliability.

1.0.0

  • Initial release of the SaaS RAG chatbot integration plugin.
